name: gsd-browser
description: Open GSD browser automation for AI agents: inspect pages, drive Chrome/Chromium, verify flows, and capture evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, test, debug, and document web apps with Chrome/Chromium.
interface.longDescription: Use gsd-browser when an AI agent needs real browser control. Features: navigate pages, click, type, fill forms, take screenshots, capture stable snapshot refs, run assertions and waits, extract structured data, compare visual diffs, inspect console/network behavior, mock or block requests, emulate devices, save auth state, record evidence bundles, and open a live viewer for human handoff. How to use it: ask your agent to inspect a URL or localhost app, verify a user flow before shipping, debug a broken page, capture screenshots, scrape page data, or show you the browser while it works. Open GSD: https://opengsd.net/. GitHub repo and docs: https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-browser.
defaultPrompt: Verify this user flow with evidence
